tools.name: createEnvelope
tools.description:
Creates a new Docusign envelope from an EXISTING Docusign template or from documents provided via a remote URL.

There are two ways to create an envelope:
(A) TEMPLATE-BASED: Call getTemplates first and confirm the exact templateId with the user.
(B) REMOTE URL DOCUMENT: Provide documents with a remoteUrl pointing to any publicly accessible HTTP/HTTPS URL that returns raw file bytes. Each document requires documentId, name, and remoteUrl. Optionally include fileExtension only if you are certain of the format — otherwise omit it and let Docusign auto-detect. The URL must return file content directly (not an HTML viewer page). Convert share links to direct-download URLs where needed. Max 25 MB per document.

CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS:
(1) For template-based envelopes, NEVER call this tool unless the user has explicitly identified a specific template by name or ID.
(2) NEVER auto-select, guess, or substitute a "similar" template — if no template is confirmed, ask the user to choose.
(3) DO NOT generate documentBase64 content — this tool does not accept base64 file uploads.
(4) Recipients and tabs are optional when using templateId (the template may already define them).
(5) When using remoteUrl documents, recipients with at least one signer are required.
tools.title: Create Envelope

tools.name: generateAccessToken
tools.description:
This tool facilitates an interactive OAuth guided access token generation flow for Docusign (JSON Web Token grant, Authorization Code Grant, or Implicit Grant).
 Helps create Integration Keys, configure OAuth settings, and obtain access tokens.

 ## Prerequisite: 
 - Before starting the flow, the tool **must** first obtain the users `accountId` using the `#getUserInfo` Tool.

  ## LLM Instructions:
 - When calling this tool, ensure to provide a "step" parameter for the "input" action using the next_step provided in the previous response.
 - Usage: Call with action="start" and accountId to begin. Then follow prompts. For each step, use action="input" with the flow_token from the previous response and step (by using next_step from the previous response).
 - When required_fields are returned, provide them nested inside the provided_fields object (NOT as top-level parameters).
 - Do not take default values for decision questions unless specified by the user.

 - Do not chain tools and actions together in a single request.

  ## Flow States:
 **REQUIRE_ACCOUNT_ID**: Prompts for Docusign Account ID if not provided initially. Required fields: ["accountId"]
 **DECISION_Q1**: Asks if application needs automated tasks. Options: "yes" (JWT recommendation), "no" (DECISION_Q2)
 **DECISION_Q2**: Asks if application can store secrets securely. Options: "yes" (Auth Code), "no" (Implicit Grant)
 **IK_INPUTS**: Collects Integration Key details. Required fields vary by flow type:
   - JWT/AUTH_CODE flows: ["app_name", "redirect_uri"]
   - IMPLICIT flow: ["app_name", "redirect_uri", "cors_origins", "httpMethods"]
 **CONSENT**: Displays OAuth consent URL. User must visit URL and grant consent before proceeding
 **JWT_ASSERTION**: Generates JWT assertion and exchanges for access token (JWT flow only)
 **AWAIT_REDIRECT**: Waits for authorization code redirect URL. Required fields: ["pasted_redirect_url", "client_id", "client_secret"]
 **AWAIT_IMPLICIT_REDIRECT**: Waits for implicit grant redirect URL with access token. Required fields: ["pasted_redirect_url"]
 **END**: Flow completion with final access token and user information

  ## Examples:
 Start: {"action": "start", "accountId": "your-account-id"}
 Input: {"action": "input", "step": "IK_INPUTS", "flow_token": "...", "provided_fields": {"app_name": "MyApp", "redirect_uri": "https://localhost:3000/callback"}}
 Format notes: `cors_origins` as comma-separated URLs, httpMethods as space-separated (e.g., "GET POST PUT")
 Tool requires account id retrieved from `#getUserInfo` Tool
tools.title: Generate Access Token

action.description: Action to perform: start new flow or continue with input

accountId.description: Docusign account ID for OAuth operations (required after first question)

step.description: Current step in the flow, required for input action when no flow_token is provided

selection_id.description: Selected option ID for multiple choice questions

provided_fields.description: IMPORTANT: A nested object containing field values as key-value pairs (NOT top-level parameters). For IK_INPUTS step, nest these fields inside provided_fields: {"app_name": "MyApp", "redirect_uri": "https://localhost:3000/callback", "cors_origins": "https://example.com,https://example.org", "httpMethods": "GET POST"}. For IMPLICIT flow, all 4 fields are required. For AUTH_CODE/JWT, only app_name and redirect_uri are required. Format: cors_origins as comma-separated URLs, httpMethods as space-separated (e.g., "GET POST PUT").

filter.description:
OData $filter expression (max 2000 chars). Use single quotes for string literals.
Supported operators:
- Comparisons: eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le
- Logic: and, or
- Set membership: in (e.g., type in ('Msa','Sow'))
Examples:
- status eq 'COMPLETE' and provisions/effective_date ge 2025-01-01
- parties/name_in_agreement eq 'Acme Corp' or parties/name_in_agreement eq 'Beta Ltd'
- provisions/renewal_type in ('EVERGREEN','AUTO_RENEW')
